title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
source: Set One: Sony L-750ESX-HFB Dynamicron SUPER HIFI VIDEO CASSETTE-> Sony SLO-1800 STEREO VIDEOCASSETTE RECORDER-> Sony PCM-601ESD DIGITAL AUDIO PROCESSOR-> SP/DIF-> Mytek Stereo 192 Sample Rate Converter-> Upsampled to 44.1kHz/24bit-> SP/DIF-> RME FIREFACE 800-> FireWire 400-> Lenovo K450e Desktop PC-> WaveLab 6.11; Set Two: DAT-> PANASONIC SV-3700-> TASCAM DA-30 (Spring 1996)-> DAT-> Panasonic SV-3800-> SP/DIF-> RME FIREFACE 800-> FireWire 400-> Lenovo K450e Desktop PC-> Adobe Audition 3.0.1; Wavelab 7.1 mastering by Jamie Waddell; Track, FLAC and Pack by John Wenzel; a project **GEMS**

ai_review.summary: Exceptionally clean soundboard capture of a legendary Fillmore night featuring guest artists and Jerry’s rare piano on “To Lay Me Down”.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its immaculate restoration – listeners describe it as crystal‑clear, a true "peerless" listening experience. The show itself is hailed as one of the greatest, highlighted by Nelson and Grisman’s surprise appearances, Phil Lesh’s electric bass on the acoustic set, and Jerry Garcia’s piano work on “To Lay Me Down”.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave five stars, emphasizing both outstanding musical performance and flawless restoration of the soundboard source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Restored from original sbd tape with pristine clarity; no noticeable noise, drop‑outs, or muddiness – described as "beautiful" and "amazing" by reviewers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Memorable night with seamless flow; guest spots (Nelson, Grisman) and unique moments like Phil’s electric bass on the acoustic set add excitement.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Rare piano performance on “To Lay Me Down” noted by reviewers.
band_member_comments.Phil: Added his electric bass to the acoustic set, a highlighted moment.
